*Tomorrow's price*

lines.say: You're budgeting your upgrade. 1,755 dollars per square foot, and that's just the land.
That was the top bid for a residential site near Orchard Road last week.
Developers buy land years before a launch. Construction, financing and profit come on top.
Analysts expect homes there at around 3,500 dollars psf.
When land costs rise, nearby launches are often priced higher too.
So check recent land bids in the area you want before you fix your budget.
Most people decide this wrongly. Comment WHY to see the mistake.
